sources_scanned: Press coverage of individual YC company launches/raises
sweep_metadata.notes: YC's Spring 2026 batch is labeled inconsistently across sources as 'P26', 'S26', and 'X26' (formerly X26, renamed P26/Spring 2026). Demo Day for this batch fell on 2026-06-16, the first day of the sweep window, generating a cluster of new robotics/physical-AI disclosures.

new_companies.name: 9 Mothers Corporation
new_companies.description: Austin-based defense-tech company building AI-powered counter-drone hardware; shipped EDDA, a 23kg autonomous turret that uses passive acoustic detection plus visual tracking to shoot down FPV attack drones at 10-100m range with a shotgun.
new_companies.founded: 2025 (per YC profile); came out of stealth June 2026
founders: Russell Smith - CEO (YC S12 co-founder of Rainforest QA, 10+ yrs as CTO)
Bogdan Pyzh - co-founder (ex-Leviathan Security Group EMEA practice lead)
new_companies.funding: Reported VC interest at $200M+ valuation following Demo Day; investors include Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, RSquared VC, Mana Ventures. $1.6M in sales to the U.S. Department of War, with a single contract reportedly expected to expand to $35M.

new_companies.name: Twolabs
new_companies.description: Builds modular semi-humanoid robots (first design: 'Tobi') plus a software platform (Record -> Upload -> Train -> Deploy) for training and deploying robots; initial focus is elder-care robots for nursing homes and senior living facilities (feeding, dressing, medication, companionship).
founders: Sardor Rahmatulloev - co-founder (Cornell CS, ex-Meta Superintelligence Labs)
Danyal Ahmad - co-founder (Georgia Tech MS in AI)
new_companies.funding: Not disclosed in available sources; 2 employees, San Francisco-based per YC profile

new_companies.name: Eden Robotics (Eden)
new_companies.description: Builds semi-humanoid robots for industrial/manufacturing and logistics work, offered as 'physical agents for hire' on a usage-based (pay-by-the-hour) model rather than outright robot sales; launched its first product, 'Eden I'.
founders: Dr. Joey Humphreys - CTO (robotics PhD, Nature Machine Intelligence publication)
new_companies.funding: No institutional funding round disclosed beyond YC; London-founded, building out in the Bay Area

new_companies.name: Avea Robotics
new_companies.description: Ultra-low-latency (as low as ~10ms) teleoperation software platform that helps robotics companies scale Physical AI data collection and deployments, integrating perception, planning, control and teleoperation for industrial robot fleets.
founders: Vikram Vadrevu - co-founder (aerospace/embedded software engineer, ex-NASA/DoD satellite flight software, UIUC)
new_companies.funding: $1.01M raised (Afore Capital, LeapYear, Pioneer Fund, Third Kind Venture Capital, Y Combinator); reported growth from 0 to $200K ARR in one month (May 2026)

new_companies.name: Human Archive
new_companies.description: Multimodal data provider for robotics and world-model training; archives real-world human interaction (50,000+ contributor network, 1,000+ custom data-capture rigs, 125+ national partnerships in India) to build datasets for embodied-AI/robotics foundation models.
new_companies.funding: $8.2M seed led by Wing Venture Capital and NVP Capital, announced 2026-05-26 (just prior to the sweep window; included here as it remained an actively discussed YC robotics-data story through the window)

new_companies.name: Maquoketa Research
new_companies.description: Builds platform-agnostic terminal guidance modules ('the intelligence layer for one-way attack drones') -- a custom object-tracking/re-acquisition algorithm running on sub-$200 hardware, reported to raise successful strike rates from under 25% to upwards of 80%.
new_companies.funding: Not disclosed beyond YC; 5 employees per YC profile

new_companies.name: Intelligence Factory
new_companies.description: 'Human Intelligence for Robots' - trains general-purpose robot manipulation models on human demonstration data captured via custom motion-capture gloves (see/do/feel), then retargets human motion to robot motion across hardware platforms.
founders: Yash Sinha - CEO (ETH Zurich robotics, ex-Founder/CTO of Kaio Labs)
Jalaj Shukla - CTO (UPenn MS Robotics & Mechatronics, ex-Dimensional, ex-Blue Sky Robotics)

new_companies.name: Cortex AI
new_companies.description: Builds large-scale real-world robot and egocentric human datasets for embodied-AI/foundation-model training (workplace video, manipulator/humanoid trajectories, human-in-the-loop rollouts and evals).
new_companies.funding: $6M seed, closed 2025-12-04 -- not a window event
new_companies.skip_reason: F25-batch company with no confirmed news inside the 2026-06-16 to 2026-06-30 window; only verifiable event is a Dec 2025 seed round.

notable_updates.note: After checking tracked companies most likely to have a YC affiliation (Viam, Serve Robotics, Path Robotics, Pickle Robot, Standard Bots, Dyna Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, Field AI, Sunday Robotics), no confirmed direct YC-portfolio connection plus in-window (2026-06-16 to 2026-06-30) news could be substantiated with a primary source. Viam (Tech Mahindra partnership, 2026-06-18-19) and Serve Robotics (board appointment, Cannes Lions sponsorship, ~2026-06-22-24) had real in-window news but no verifiable direct YC backing -- Viam's investors are Tiger Global/USV/Battery, and Serve Robotics spun out of Postmates/Uber rather than YC directly.
notable_updates.skip_reason: No tracked company with a confirmed YC connection had verifiable in-window news after 2 rounds of search.
